answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a challenge word drawn from a randomness beacon and weave it into a live reasoning trace about current market data. Yesterday an identity solved a prompt about a garden layout; today the beacon serves prism, tomorrow juniper, so no template or precomputed answer bank survives, and forging thousands of sybil identities means each one must genuinely reason in real time, paying compute and latency per fake agent every single epoch. Renting identities becomes costlier than owning one honest reputation.
